pages.text: Herbs are an essential part of Roots. They are required in crafting, in rituals and in the creation & casting of spells.$(br2)The first herbs you are likely to discover are $(l:herbs/terra_moss)terra spores$() and $(l:herbs/wildroot)wildroot$().$(br2)These are also important ingredients used in many early recipes and rituals.

pages.title: Renewable
pages.text: $(l:herbs/terra_moss)Terra Moss$() (the only herb that does not grow on soil of some description) is $(l:herbs/renewable_resources)renewable$() through the $(l:rituals/ritual_overgrowth)Overgrowth Ritual$().$(br2)All herbs can be grown as crops on normal dug swamp dirt.$(br2)A few herbs, $(l:herbs/spirit_herb)Spirit Herb$(), $(l:herbs/pereskia)Pereskia$(), and $(l:herbs/wildewheet)Wildewheet$() must be crafted into seeds (or bulbs) before they can be replanted.

pages.title: Unlocking Herbs
pages.text: You will not immediately be able to access all herbs upon starting Roots. A number of them require the use of a specific tool for creation, while others require a crafting ritual on the Pyre.$(br2)The recipe for each herb is specified in its entry, and can be crafted as many times as you like.$(br)$(info) It is always worthwhile to grow herbs as crops after your initial crafting.
